scenarios.scenario_abstract: During an ordinary sick day at home, [X] alternates between chills and sweating after measuring a low fever and therefore considers a light T-shirt and removable thin sweater that allow arm coverage to be reduced when warmth rises and restored when chills return, without treating clothing as a cure or assuming either garment is already owned.
examples: starting with a light base beneath a removable upper layer
clearing more of the arms when sweating begins
restoring coverage when chills return
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一个普通的居家病休日里，[X]测得低烧，并在发冷与出汗之间反复变化，因此会考虑轻薄 T 恤和可脱的薄毛衣，让体温升高时能够减少手臂遮盖、寒战回来时再恢复遮盖，同时不把衣物当作治疗手段，也不假设候选衣物已经归自己所有。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Traveling from Italy with two friends, [X] prepares one small bag for a four-day spring break in Seville built around long city walks, sunny plazas, tapas, and evening outings. The group's few tops need different degrees of arm coverage for warm afternoons, cooler nights, possible showers, and one neater social look without expanding the capsule.
examples: using minimal arm coverage during a sunny afternoon walk
choosing an intermediate length for a day that continues into dinner
packing one fully covering option beneath a light evening layer
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]和另外两位意大利朋友各带一个小包，准备到塞维利亚度过四天春季假期，安排包括长距离城市步行、阳光广场、塔帕斯和晚间外出。三人的少量上衣需要用不同程度的手臂遮盖应对温暖午后、较凉夜晚、可能的阵雨和一次更整洁的社交造型，又不能把胶囊衣橱越扩越大。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While helping prepare children in the family for a winter holiday in South Africa, [X] expects cold mornings, midday warmth that permits layers to come off, and renewed chill with possible mosquitoes at outdoor dusk. [X] therefore needs children's tops whose arm coverage a parent can easily add, reduce, and restore across the same day.
examples: starting a child in a covering top on a cold morning
reducing arm coverage during the warmer middle of the day
restoring secure coverage before an outdoor dusk activity
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为家中孩子准备南非冬季假期时，[X]要应对寒冷清晨、暖到可以逐层脱衣的正午，以及再次降温并可能出现蚊虫的户外黄昏，因此需要让家长能在同一天里方便地增加、减少并重新恢复孩子上衣的手臂遮盖。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: The night before a high-stakes exam, [X] lays out a low-bulk base and a zip layer that can be adjusted discreetly because the testing center may be heavily air-conditioned while nervous sweating could make a fixed warm top uncomfortable. This combination lets [X] change arm coverage without interrupting check-in, desk work, or concentration.
examples: keeping a low-bulk base beneath the zip layer
using fuller arm coverage in a cold testing room
opening or removing the outer layer when nervous warmth rises
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场重要考试的前夜，[X]提前摆好轻薄打底和一件可低调调节的拉链外层，因为考场可能冷气很强，而紧张出汗又会让固定的保暖上衣变得难受；这样的组合能让[X]改变手臂遮盖，而不打断入场、伏案答题或注意力。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a two-night Atlantic-coast weekend in Ericeira, [X] moves from a surf lesson and exposed cliff walk into a polished Portuguese dinner. With very few changes of top available, [X] uses the amount of arm coverage to bridge post-activity heat, ocean wind, and the smarter evening setting instead of packing a separate outfit for each stage.
examples: changing into a lightly covering top after the surf lesson
using intermediate coverage on a breezy cliff walk
choosing a fuller dinner top that still fits under a light jacket
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在埃里塞拉度过两晚的大西洋海岸周末时，[X]会从冲浪课和无遮蔽的悬崖步行转入较精致的葡萄牙晚餐。可替换的上衣极少，因此[X]需要借助手臂遮盖量衔接运动后的热感、海风和更整洁的晚间场合，而不是为每个阶段重复准备服装。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While preparing wearable protection for Hawaii, [X] has to reconcile humid heat and strong ultraviolet exposure with mosquitoes around dawn and dusk and other outdoor excursions. [X] compares tops by how much skin they cover without becoming impractical in tropical heat.
examples: covering more of the arms during a mosquito-prone outing
using lighter partial coverage in humid heat
limiting exposed skin during prolonged sun
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为夏威夷准备可穿戴防护时，[X]需要同时应对湿热、强紫外线、清晨和黄昏的蚊虫以及其他户外活动，并按候选上衣能覆盖多少皮肤、同时又不会在热带高温中过于难穿来进行比较。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While making an oil painting as a birthday gift, [X] prepares old work clothes for a long session involving wet paint, a palette, brush cleaning, and ventilated solvent use. [X] needs a work top whose cuffs stay clear of the active hand area while balancing forearm mobility with protection from splashes and smears.
examples: keeping the arms fully clear for precise brushwork
ending coverage before the busiest part of the forearm
securing a fuller sleeve so its cuff cannot cross the palette
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把油画作为生日礼物制作时，[X]会为涉及湿颜料、调色板、洗笔和通风使用溶剂的长时间创作准备旧工作衣。工作上衣既要让袖口远离主要手部操作区，又要在前臂活动余量与防止飞溅和蹭污之间取得平衡。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Packing lightly for a one-week Bangkok-and-Krabi trip, [X] plans for humid sightseeing, beaches, island activities, and a temple day that requires covered shoulders. The small top capsule needs shorter or sleeveless options for heat and water-adjacent time, plus tops with reliable shoulder and arm coverage for cultural sites and cool transit.
examples: using minimal arm coverage during beach time
choosing a shoulder-covering top for the temple visit
keeping a fuller option for transit or strongly cooled interiors
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为一周的曼谷和甲米之行轻装打包时，[X]要兼顾湿热环境下的观光、海滩、岛屿项目以及要求遮住肩部的寺庙日。小型上衣组合既要有适合高温和临水活动的无袖或短袖选择，也要有能可靠遮住肩臂、适合文化场所和冷气交通的上衣。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a June weekend in Sedona, [X] begins rocky hikes before sunrise to avoid dangerous afternoon heat, then moves across exposed red-rock trails, shaded rest periods, swimming time, and evening stargazing. As the day progresses, [X] compares breathable tops by the tradeoff among arm coverage, exertion heat, and prolonged sun.
examples: starting a cool dawn hike with more of the arms covered
reducing coverage as climbing and heat build
using sun-covering sleeves on a long exposed trail without trapping too much heat
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在六月的塞多纳周末，[X]为避开危险的午后高温而在日出前开始岩石徒步，随后经历无遮蔽的红岩路线、阴凉休息、游泳和晚间观星。随着一天推进，[X]需要在少量透气上衣的手臂遮盖、运动发热和长时间日晒之间不断权衡。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a date that combines a chilly sunset picnic with a drive-in movie, [X] and a partner move from damp outdoor ground and cooling air into a blanket-filled car where they eat and recline for several hours. [X] needs one planned top that keeps the arms warm outside while leaving cuffs and elbows comfortable around food, blankets, and confined seating.
examples: using substantial arm coverage while setting up the picnic
choosing an intermediate length beneath a shared blanket
keeping cuffs out of food and comfortable while reclining
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场把寒凉日落野餐与汽车影院合并起来的约会中，[X]和伴侣会从潮湿的户外地面和不断降温的空气转入铺满毯子的车内，并在那里吃东西、斜躺数小时。[X]计划的一件上衣既要在户外让手臂保暖，也要让袖口和肘部在食物、毯子和狭窄座位之间保持舒适。
